backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor placeholder with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping implemented Valentine app features to source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing their roles in the Valentine app flow and effects.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme definitions for Valentine styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component controlling the 5-screen Valentine flow and rendering the audio toggle.
frontend/src/components/AudioToggle.tsx: Button toggling background music using useRomanticMusic with volume icons.
frontend/src/components/ConfettiBurst.ts: Generates 50 timed falling confetti pieces with randomized properties and auto-clears after 4s.
frontend/src/components/DodgeMessageToas: Animated toast bubble showing playful dodge messages when the NO button moves.
frontend/src/components/HeartsRain.tsx: Generates falling heart images with random size and timing, clearing after 6s.
frontend/src/components/ValentineScreenS: Centered layout wrapper providing consistent Valentine-themed container for screens.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity and React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useDodgingNoButton.ts: Hook computing random NO-button positions and exposing pointer handlers for dodge behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder returning no backend queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useRomanticMusic.ts: Manages play/pause state for a placeholder looping audio element respecting autoplay rules.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive Valentine-themed CSS variables plus utility classes for themed colors and backgrounds.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and loads the main App component.
frontend/src/screens/BigQuestionScreen.t: Renders the main Valentine question with YES and dodging NO buttons, including random toast messages.
frontend/src/screens/BuildUpScreen.tsx: Shows a lead‑in message and a button that advances to the big question.
frontend/src/screens/IntroScreen.tsx: Displays an introductory greeting and a continue button to start the flow.
frontend/src/screens/SweetEndingScreen.t: Shows a final sweet message and a heart animation after the flow ends.
frontend/src/screens/YesCelebrationScree: Runs celebration effects after YES is chosen and reveals a continue button after a delay.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with Valentine color tokens, extended theme settings, plugins, and dark mode.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requirements, and image specifications for the Valentine micro‑app.
